content:
# Bare Stack: S3 Logs Bucket + IAM Grants

I'll add the logs bucket and grant permissions in each environment independently, following the bare stack's plainly authored manifest pattern.

**Assumptions on existing service principal names** (inferred from `myapp-assets-{env}` naming convention):
- Dev: `myapp-service-user` (User)
- Prod: `myapp-service-role` (Role)

If your existing `iam.yaml` uses different names, adjust `userName` and `roleName` accordingly.

---

`dev/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
spec:
  bucket: myapp-logs-dev
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`dev/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: UserPolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  userName: myapp-service-user
  policyName: myapp-logs-policy
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

---

`prod/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
spec:
  bucket: myapp-logs-prod
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
        sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`prod/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: RolePolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  roleName: myapp-service-role
  policyName: myapp-logs-policy
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

---

## Application

Deploy with:
```bash
kubectl apply -f dev/logs-bucket.yaml -f dev/logs-policy.yaml
kubectl apply -f prod/logs-bucket.yaml -f prod/logs-policy.yaml
```

Each environment's bucket and permissions are fully self-contained; changes in one directory have no effect on the other.
